title: EDX Markets and VerifiedX Partner to Bring Verified Bitcoin (vBTC) to Institutional Markets
summary: Bitcoin Magazine EDX Markets and VerifiedX Partner to Bring Verified Bitcoin (vBTC) to Institutional Markets Partnership will bring vBTC to EDX Markets for institutional spot trading, while EDX joins the VerifiedX network as a validator, expanding institutional access to tokenized, programmable Bitcoin infrastructure. This post EDX Markets and VerifiedX Partner to Bring Verified Bitcoin (vBTC) to Institutional Markets first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .
